summary: Recover implicit Detransitive sense 1: gehört werden; zu hören sein.
rationale: Inherited Detransitive boxes have no parsed sense list; new finite forms share their hearing/availability meaning.

summary: Correct the final consonant of šoməʕ.
rationale: The supplied Turoyo of 24/278 has kšoməʕ, with ʕ, agreeing with the entry's root šmʕ and base form šoməʕ. The entry instead has ḥ; this is not a clitic or vowel normalization.

summary: Restore the first-person ending in šŭmaʕno-wo.
rationale: The supplied verse has 'lo šumaʕnowo', first-person singular, matching maṯnowo and the translation 'ich ... gehört hätte'. The entry omits no and thus changes the person of the hearing verb.

summary: New box ko-Preterit: example for sense 1 in ko-Preterit (52/70)

data.turoyo: Fayəš komalli: "Ya aḥuno, kobaʕno minux. Košamiʕat hul larke, bas yo!" Ono məllile: "Kamela!"
data.translation: Dann sprach er zu mir: Bruder, ich bitte dich: Du hast meine Geschichte jetzt bis hierher gehört. Laß es genug sein! Ich aber sprach: Erzähle sie zu Ende!

rationale: New ko-Preterit box; overt ko- with qaṭəl and current stopping point.

summary: New box Preterit: example for sense 1 in Preterit (Lahdo Traitor 1/78)

data.turoyo: W hawxa yaʕni, xəd kuḏʕutu, šmiʕ yaʕni b briṯo kula.
data.translation: And this is, as you may have heard, this case was known all over the world.

rationale: New Detransitive Preterit box; public knowledge result.

summary: New box Preterit: example for sense 1 in Preterit (Lahdo Traitor 2/41)

data.turoyo: W i ṣbuṯaṯe yaʕni xəd ḥzelux bi ṣbuṯayo diḏi, du sayfo d šmiʕo ġalabe, šmiʕo wa.
data.translation: And this matter, as you already have seen, through my dispute about the genocide, and that had created a great echo, that was heard,

rationale: Feminine finite form supports Detransitive Preterit rather than Part. Pass. with expected -to.

summary: New box Preterit-wa: example for sense 1 in Preterit-wa (Lahdo Traitor 2/41)

data.turoyo: W i ṣbuṯaṯe yaʕni xəd ḥzelux bi ṣbuṯayo diḏi, du sayfo d šmiʕo ġalabe, šmiʕo wa.
data.translation: And this matter, as you already have seen, through my dispute about the genocide, and that had created a great echo, that was heard,

rationale: New Detransitive Preterit-wa box; separately written wa retained.

summary: New box Infectum: example for sense 1 in Infectum (Jan 3.15/175)

data.turoyo: Xori ʕAziz w ġer kuhne kmitašməʕi (m laf ar riše di dawle) bu medano. Xori ʕAziz, ʕal d kətwe bu zabnano ḥrimo mu faṭəryarxo, aṯi l Awruppa. Markawlele b kul dukṯo noše muxbərǧiye bayn das səryoye.
data.translation: Father Aziz and other priests are informed of this (by the heads of the state). Father Aziz, because he was at that time excommunicated by the patriarch, came to Europe. Everywhere he installed informers among the Syriacs.

rationale: First III Detransitive Infectum attestation, with explicit source and content; preserve the parenthetical mən phrase.

summary: New sense 1: (mit b-; mən-) benachrichtigt werden, etwas mitgeteilt bekommen (Detrans.)

data.gloss: (mit b-; mən-) benachrichtigt werden, etwas mitgeteilt bekommen (Detrans.)

rationale: kmitašməʕi has informed persons as subject, b- content and an explicit mən-marked information source. Single clear attestation of the Detransitive counterpart to inherited hören lassen.

summary: example for sense 1 in Part act. (Bilgic Lieber einen Gesellen als einen Prinzen/1)

data.turoyo: Šlomo, abri, lay yatiwe w laš šamoʕe.
data.translation: Schlomo mein Sohn, den Sitzenden und Hörenden.
data.ref: Bilgic Lieber einen Gesellen als einen Prinzen/1

rationale: Second Part act. example; independently intelligible greeting to listeners.

evidence.cite: Bilgic Lieber einen Gesellen als einen Prinzen/1

summary: example for sense 1 in Preterit Intransitive (Hors 1/83)

data.turoyo: Kətwa aʕman me Aġri, hanək ze ṭaye wayne, šamiʕi qolayye, hənnək bari minan nafiqi, azzehən, mərranne, əmmi: "U ḥa d moḥe laš šaxṣani, gqəṭlina ḥḏoḏe."
data.translation: Wir hatten (Leute) aus Aßrı dabei, das waren auch Muslime. Sie hörten ihre Stimmen, sie gingen vor uns hinaus und sagten zu (den Lasen): Wenn einer diese Leute schlägt, bringen wir uns gegenseitig um.

rationale: Existing Preterit Intransitive cell is ample, but this explicit nominal stimulus is a material experiencer-coding counterexample.

summary: example for sense 1 in Preterit Intransitive (97/51)

data.turoyo: Omər i kačke, d šamiʕo u xabrano du aḥuno, bay yawmoṯe gəmkayfo w kəxlo w šətyo w gnoyaḥla, aṯyo li ḏ̣arbo d meqəm Sətti Bədur.
data.translation: Als das Mädchen hörte, was der Bruder sagte, vergnügte es sich ein paar Tage, aß und trank und wurde frisch und gesund wie zuvor.

rationale: A second clear qaṭəl plus unmarked lexical stimulus independently corroborates the coding counterpattern; contextual finite feminine -o.

summary: example for sense 1 in Preterit-wa (Lahdo Traitor 1/10)

data.turoyo: W omanno: "Yaʕni ono, ono šaməʕwayno ġalabe medone aṣaṣ meqəm ste šaməʕwayno, ono, i emo d babi, ono me ʕIwardo no ste, yaʕni xəd məlli, i emo d babi ḥzela u sayfo, hiya ʕayišole.
data.translation: And I said, I had earlier heard lots of things (about the massacres), I am originally from cIwardo, and my grandmother witnessed and survived the massacre (so I had heart a lot).

rationale: Thin Preterit-wa cell; clear zero-marked ġalabe medone with first-person experiencer.

summary: example for sense 1 in Preterit-wa (69/371)

data.turoyo: Šamiʕiwa b əšme d Aḥmad, laʔənnahu qaṭəʕ, ṭarəq l exər daraǧe wa.
data.translation: Nun hatten sie von Aḥmad gehört, weil er ein äußerst schlimmer Wegelagerer war.

rationale: Third Preterit-wa example; b-marked stimulus provides the contrasting coding pattern.

summary: example for sense 1 in Infectum-wa (JL 18.7/12)

data.turoyo: Hawino hul yarḥo karr. Əzzawayna aṣ=ṣubayiye obənwaylan dars, lo=šomaʕwayno. Faqat bəṯr me yarḥo, ḥəlli aḏni hula w šqila, əšmo=əšmo ftiḥo.
data.translation: Ich war einen Monat lang taub. Wir gingen zu den Offizieren in den Unterricht, doch ich hörte nichts. Doch nach einem Monat merkte ich, daß mein Ohr wieder funktionierte (wörtl.: es nahm und gab), ganz allmählich öffnete es sich wieder.

rationale: Unusual first-person Infectum-wa auditory incapacity with month-long deafness; existing cell is otherwise ample.

summary: example for sense 1 in Infectum (115/284)

data.turoyo: Bas mede ḥa kobaʕne minux, kobaʕno, m uʕdo w hul ramḥəl ṣafro, šəmʕət mini.
data.translation: Aber ich bitte dich um eins: Von diesem Augenblicke an bis morgen früh mußt du auf mich hören.

rationale: Recurring mən- advice construction not represented by inherited l-suffix example.

summary: example for sense 1 in Infectum (MAC NI Aḥmad Aġa Oṣman Aġa/97)

data.turoyo: Ḥayra dsaymutu bdiḏi, dšəmʕutu xabri, bəṯər məd azzayo ṭrawu mina.
data.translation: Buddy, if you were to do it my way, if you were to follow my advice, since she is gone, leave her be
data.ref: MAC NI Aḥmad Aġa Oṣman Aġa/97

rationale: Explicit parallel with doing as advised distinguishes heeding from auditory perception.

evidence.cite: MAC NI Aḥmad Aġa Oṣman Aġa/97

summary: example for sense 1 in Infinitiv (MAC Ishaq Material culture/33)

data.turoyo: M. Bu+Sayfo harke normál, mede lawi. U+ʕamo latəm b̰ Mōr Malke. Lu+gorā̀n, ṭabi, du+maḏʕo, du+šmoʕo, layimi b̰ Mōr Malke, ŭ tamo yani mdafaʕʕe ruḥayye ʕam ḥḏoḏe, aq+qəryawoṯe, yani...
data.translation: M. During the Genocide, here was normal, nothing happened. The people gathered in Mor Malke. According to the information, to the rumours, they gathered in Mor Malke, and there, like, they defended themselves together, the villages, like...

rationale: Second inherited Detransitive Infinitiv example; hearsay use, not evidence of an additional finite box.

summary: example for sense 1 in Preterit (11/206)

data.turoyo: Maḥwilile i makina, mašġiloli, mašmaʕlile u mede, d kətwo ba.
data.translation: Da zeigte ich ihm das Gerät, setzte es in Gang und ließ ihn hören, was darauf war.

rationale: Thin III Preterit cell; explicit content and suffixal hearer.

summary: example for sense 1 in Preterit (24/117)

data.turoyo: Iḏa nuqṣaniye mede aṯi aʕlux, aw l nošo mašmaʕlelux xabre lo basime, malli, ḥatta d umalle l babi, gəmǧazele!"
data.translation: Wenn es dir an etwas fehlt, oder jemand dir etwas Unangenehmes gesagt hat, so sage es mir, damit ich es dem Vater sage und er den betreffenden bestraft!"

rationale: Fourth III Preterit example; human causee plus unpleasant words.

summary: example for sense 1 in Infectum (Hors 2/80)

data.turoyo: Hano, u darwešayḏan, mofaqle kṯowo me taḥtetəšʕe w ftəḥle w bdele l qəm ruḥe qore ebe, lo komašmaʕlan.
data.translation: Unser Derwisch zog ein Buch unter der Achsel hervor, öffnete esund begann für sich darin zu lesen. Er las uns nicht etwa vor.

rationale: Fourth III Infectum example; private reading with negated causative hearing.

summary: example for sense 1 in Infectum (Lahdo Traitor 1/78)

data.turoyo: Gmašmaʕno qoli b briṯo kula w koṭəlbina u ḥaqqayḏan.
data.translation: I will make my voice heard all over the world and we are, we are demanding our rights.

rationale: Fifth III Infectum example; voice rather than hearer as direct object.

summary: example for sense 1 in Infectum-wa (JTM 1.3/38)

data.turoyo: Kito ʕade mə meqəm, hayo baṭilo uʕdo, bas hawxa wa, i naqla bəṯr məd aḏiʕi ḥḏoḏe, d hawən aṯto w gawro, mašməʕiwo u ahəl dəṯṯe, məḥanwo tfənge, w mhalhəliwo,
data.translation: Es gab früher einen Brauch, der jetzt nicht mehr üblich ist, aber es war so: Nachdem sie einander erkannt hatten und Mann und Frau geworden waren, benachrichtigten sie ihre Verwandtschaft, man gab einen Gewehrschuss ab und man brach in Freudentriller aus.

rationale: Third III Infectum-wa example; explicit hearer notification in recurrent custom.

summary: example for sense 1 in Infectum-wa (11/188)

data.turoyo: B lalyo naqqawoṯo mašmaʕnowo laḥ ḥaḏ̣irayḏan, aq qole wa zməryoṯani. Kul, d šəmʕiwo, məfṣəḥiwo w zaydiwo.
data.translation: Des Nachts ließ ich manchmal unsere anwesenden diese Gesänge und Lieder hören. So oft sie sie hörten, freuten sie sich, und es wurden ihrer immer mehr.

rationale: Fourth III Infectum-wa example; l-marked hearers with zero-marked sound content.

summary: example for sense 1 in Infectum-wa (MAC Ishaq Material culture/61)

data.turoyo: tešmiʕo di+qriṯo, gmašmʕiwa i+qriṯo. Kul+ḥa bu+šəklawo oṯənwa.
data.translation: a village transmission, they would let the (whole) village hear. That way, everybody would come.

rationale: Index the finite verb in Infectum-wa while retaining the inherited Infinitiv example containing its action noun.

summary: example for sense 1 in Imperativ (Jan 1.21/1005)

data.turoyo: Qamayto šmaʕlan w bəṯər mḥawtəklan.
data.translation: First listen to us, then drive us away.

rationale: Thin Imperativ cell after round 1; overt personal listening target -lan in a self-contained demand.

summary: example for sense 1 in Preterit-wa (Jan 1.22/1149)

data.turoyo: Ǧan: As səryoyani d əzzənwo l Mawṣal, aydarbo šəmʕiwo, kit hawxa mede w əzzənwo?
data.translation: Jan: These Syriacs who had gone to Mosul, how had they heard that such a thing existed, and gone?

rationale: Preterit-wa sense 1 has three examples after round 1; an explicit question about prior information adds a clear anterior context, morphology provisional.

summary: example for sense 1 in Infinitiv (Jan 2.10/2544)

data.turoyo: Haṯe b adni šaməʕnola, yaʕni lo šmoʕo kəlle kmaḥkeno, <...>
data.translation: I heard this with my own ears, that is, I am not here telling it from hearsay. <...>

rationale: Thin inherited Detransitive Infinitiv cell; explicit contrast of direct hearing with hearsay.

summary: example for sense 1 in Infinitiv (Jan 2.14/3377)

data.turoyo: Xori Brahim: Šmoʕo šaməʕina. <...>
data.translation: Father Brahim: We have heard it by hearsay. <...>

rationale: Thin Infinitiv cell; cognate nominal plus finite verb explicitly marks a hearsay source.

summary: example for sense 1 in Preterit (Jan 3.15/161)

data.turoyo: <...> "Yabo, bi maḥkame xəd ṯbat mašməʕalli i ǧġaliyayḏi, fayəšno mḥayro, aydarbo griš hawxa ḥəs diḏi." <...>
data.translation: <...> “Well, in court they played my words to me as evidence. I was left bewildered: how was my voice recorded like that?” <...>

rationale: III Preterit/1 reaches five after round 1; recorded speech as overt content and recipient suffix.

summary: Restore y in the possessed form of walaye.
rationale: The cited Turoyo reads 'Qm i walayayḏe'; the entry has wala-ayḏe, lacking the stem-final y before the possessive ending. The same entry batch has walay-ayḏe in šql.idiom.12. Preserve the surrounding segmentation.

summary: Sense 1: revise the gloss
after: hören; glauben; (mit l- oder mən; auch mit xabro) auf jmdn. hören, jmdm. folgen;
rationale: Makes existing advice-heeding at 24/288 explicit and adds the recurring mən- authority construction; retains hearing and believing.

summary: Preterit Intransitive qaṭəl can take an unmarked lexical stimulus: Hors 1/83 qolayye and 97/51 u xabrano du aḥuno, alongside inherited 24/217 əšmə-d-Šahrzamān. These disprove a categorical ban; they do not quantify a preference.

Lahdo Traitor 1/10 ġalabe medone adds an unmarked stimulus with Preterit-wa. By contrast 69/371 has b əšme; 11/274 u abro may instead be a topic within a clausal stimulus. Count demonstratives, clauses and clitic-resumed topics separately.
III allows the hearer as direct or l-marked argument and auditory content as another object or recoverable clause. Notification and voice projection fit inherited hören lassen.
Detransitive publicity forms contrast with the impersonal capacity-to-hear construction at 3/44. Keep the action noun in the inherited Infinitiv section without deriving a finite analysis from it.
Do not infer object coding from unresolved šamiʕalla or person from a free English translation; the clear nominal counterexamples stand independently.
Jan supports the round-1 distinction between hearer, auditory content, information source and authority heeded. Resumed hən mənayye ... -lle is not an unresumed bare stimulus.
Reduced šəmʕiwo/šəmʕinawo do not securely distinguish Preterit-wa from Infectum-wa. Repeated/habitual reference can guide interpretation but cannot restore missing vowels.
The cognate nominal šmoʕo contrasts hearsay with b adni direct hearing. Retain the inherited Detransitive Infinitiv filing without interpreting the nominal as a Detransitive event.
Literary Syriac šmaʕtun and biblical šmaʕ occur inside marked quoted discourse; their presence is a register observation, not a new Turoyo conjugation.
Check šamiʕalla at MAC NE Samson/1, Dawid/24 and Joseph/45, and Talay 2/17 šaməʕna: person endings, content clitics and possible repairs cannot be resolved from the supplied text.
Lahdo Traitor 2/41: verify finite šmiʕo and the separately written wa; absence of feminine -to supports the proposed Detransitive finite boxes.
30/18: compare inherited šŭmaʕ-wo with assigned šumaʕnowo before correcting the source transcription; the first-person -no is missing in the current example.

The inherited III Infinitiv citation MlfI_Houses2/64 corresponds in wording to assigned MAC Ishaq Material culture/61. Verify the recording/edition reference mapping; retain the noun example and index the finite verb separately.
PrS 24/53: verify final ḥ in Šaməḥ; preserve the source spelling. 29/468 šaməʕle also needs suffix analysis rather than automatic reassignment to Preterit.
Confirm reduced šəmʕiwo/šəmʕinawo boxes and agreement, particularly the hard-of-hearing man versus his plural ears at Jan 1.40/1798.
Resolve šamiʕono (Jan 4.I/465): qaṭəl plus person ending or another construction? Its form does not match inherited Part act. šamoʕo.
Collate bare šaməʕ (Jan 1.36/1525), šaməʕituyo (Jan 1.53/2558), and šəmʕalle (Jan 4.I/228) before making person-ending claims.
Clarify šamiʕi biyya ləwole (Jan 2.23/4262): unwillingness to consider the sale or absence of prior knowledge?
Restore the missing g in große.
rationale: The entry has the nonword 'roße'; the supplied translation of 24/241 reads 'große und kleine', corresponding to rabe w-naʕime.

summary: Correct the dative ending in aus ihrem Munde.
rationale: Munde is dative singular after aus; the possessive must be ihrem. The same grammatical typo is present in the supplied edition translation, but is independently evident in German.

summary: Capitalize the German noun Menschen.
rationale: Menschen is a noun here. The supplied edition translation also has 'keines Menschen Stimme'.

summary: Restore the missing l in wälzte.
rationale: The German verb is wälzen, past tense wälzte. 'wäzte' is a spelling error; the supplied check only quotes verse 69/195, so it does not independently verify the following plate action.

summary: Correct the imperative lass.
rationale: The Turoyo imperative mašmaʕ-li and the supplied edition translation 'lass mich mal hören' require lass, not the past tense las.

summary: Information targets occur with ʕal about-phrases and mən personal sources; hearing of a telephone is a technical participant extension under the same sense.

A state informs a person, recorded words are played to a recipient, and the Vatican is a possible institutional recipient. These support round-1 notification/voice-projection analysis without a duplicate sense.
